recordSet.description: Station metadata from WSV/GDWS's PEGELONLINE service (https://www.pegelonline.wsv.de/webservices/rest-api/v2). This RivRetrieve projection selected the fields below from the published station catalogue; source names and absence remain unchanged. The `elevation` field's `w_unit` datum association records the W timeseries' own native unit (`cm`, `m+NN` or `m+PNP`) alongside its `gaugeZero` value, not a geodetic elevation datum code, so a later conversion step can find the vertical-datum regime without re-fetching the source. PEGELONLINE's terms page states the licence `DL-DE->Zero-2.0` over information, products and services from the site with no origin-based exception.
